_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-office-files-to-pdf (REQ-OPDF-001 to REQ-OPDF-003, matrix row age-17). An Office paper added to a meeting or an agenda item is converted to PDF through filinq; the object records each paper, its PDF and the backend, or why it was not converted. Keys are written only when they hold a value, so no property is nullable.
